physicalTimeRules: seasonalHungerStreak uses physical trailing exposure days divided by 90; existing >=2 semantic retained
chronicDeficitStreak uses physical trailing exposure days divided by 90; existing >=4/6/8 semantics retained
deficitSeasonsLast4 >=1 in classifyHunger is a one-season physical deficit signal; deficitSeasonsLast4/8 and waterStressSeasonsLast8 retain their existing season-equivalent comparisons
canonical chronicFoodStress/recoveryRelief remain duration-weighted from the physical streaks; they are not record-count gates
correctedMaturityRules: 1 and 89 qualifying recovery days remain immediate improvement only; 90 days classify recovery_after_crisis
intentionallyDurationWeighted: socialContext recovery signal multiplies seasonalRecoveryStreak as a graded duration signal
protoCamps consumes recovery classifications rather than a raw maturity comparison
innerFission accepts seasonal_pulse_recovery for immediate recovery and recovery_after_crisis for mature recovery only when the current support projection is fully covered
unrelatedCountChecks: protoCamps activity/visit/knowledge counts remain event-existence checks, not physical recovery maturity
bandHistory recoveryYears > 0 records existence of a historical recovery year, not the seasonal maturity gate
additionalCoverageReaders: innerFission.ts:280-289 fully-covered guard on unity recovery
